caption: The drawing features a single rabbit-like animal with a simplified form, sitting upright on its haunches and facing to the right. The creature is rendered in pale grey with some shading to indicate contours, and it has faint blue marks scattered on its back and body. Its nose and eyes are small and dark, with the eyes appearing reddish-brown. The inner ears are highlighted with lighter tones. The tail is small and round, with a darker ring around it. The background is plain and off-white without any additional objects or scenery. In the lower right corner, the artist's signature, "ALEX BUSH," is present in blue, capitalized letters.
title: Rabbit
